messages:
erin: Pager triggered — canary encoder pods crashing after 21:00 deploy in us-east-1. 3/5 pods in CrashLoopBackOff, 5xx spike on /v1/generate. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/canary
incident-bot: PD: SEV2 page sent to bob (oncall). Alert: https://go/alerts/4912345678 — threshold: 5xx rate > 3% for 2m
deploy-bot: Deploy metadata: encoder service rolled -> release v3.4.2, canary 40%, initiated by @alice at 21:00 UTC. HPA autoscaled from 3->5 recently
bob: I'm oncall, looking. Pausing further rollout and preparing kill-switch. @alice — paste latest pod logs and canary manifest diff
alice: pausing traffic towards canary: `kubectl scale deploy encoder-canary -n prod --replicas=0`
alice: logs from encoder-canary-3f9b (last lines):
```
2026-03-16T21:02:18Z ERROR OOMKilled: process killed allocating 1.2GB
2026-03-16T21:02:19Z WARN memory usage spiked, model_max_tokens=65536
2026-03-16T21:02:19Z INFO restarting container
```
carla: manifest diff looks like: v3.4.2 bumped MODEL_MAX_TOKENS 16384 -> 65536 and removed memory limit (was 6Gi -> now unset). HPA has minReplicas=1 maxReplicas=10 targetCPU=40 causing scale thrash when memory spikes
bob: that config would explain OOM loops. Action: enable feature-flag fallback, then rollback canary to v3.3.9. @carla can you flip the flag?
carla: toggling fallback flag now via LD: `ldctl flag set enc-fallback true --env prod` — toggled. Traffic routed to stable model code path.
deploy-bot: Triggering rollback: `./deploy rollback encoder --to v3.3.9 --namespace prod` — rollback job queued
alice: watching pods: `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=encoder -w` — new stable pods coming up Ready
carla: quick impact summary: us-east-1 saw ~5% 5xx and 12m of elevated latency; two customers (acme-corp, beta-ops) reported errors via support. No data loss. SLO exposure window ~15m
bob: notifying Support & Trust. Creating customer-facing blurb and posting to status page. Also opening short-term mitigation ticket to re-add memory limits and lower MODEL_MAX_TOKENS
frank: oncall takeover request noted. bob — handing post-incident follow-up to me for RCA and patch. I'll coordinate tomorrow morning.
alice: rollback complete — stable pods v3.3.9 at 5/5 ready. Error rate trending back to baseline over last 3 minutes
carla: monitoring shows memory and CPU normalized. HPA back to steady state. We'll patch manifest to set hard memory limits and restore MODEL_MAX_TOKENS to 16384 for now
incident-bot: Incident resolved: Rollback completed at 21:18 UTC. SEV2 -> resolved. Postmortem assigned to frank. Incident page: https://go/incidents/4912345678
bob: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
frank: I'll run RCA and list action items (manifest fix, pre-merge safety check for memory-related env changes, add canary resource validation). Will post in #postmortems tomorrow morning
